name: DC disk free capacity
description: Latest LogicalDisk % Free Space per DC and disk instance in the requested range. Disk instances remain separate and _Total is excluded; low free capacity is red, high free capacity green.
kql:
Perf
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where ObjectName == 'LogicalDisk' and CounterName == '% Free Space' and InstanceName != '_Total'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue) by Computer, InstanceName
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Series = Computer, Dimension = InstanceName, Value = round(CounterValue, 2)
| order by Value asc
